newsitem.title: TURKEY: Another bomb blast at Turkish Islamist party.
newsitem.headline: Another bomb blast at Turkish Islamist party.

text.p: A small bomb exploded at an office of Turkey's Islam-based Welfare Party on Wednesday, the second such attack against the party in three days, Anatolian news agency said.
It said there were no casualties in the blast in Istanbul's Fatih district, an Islamist neighbourhood. A bomb broke the windows of a Welfare office in another part of the city on Monday.

Welfare is the main opposition party. It is led by Necmettin Erbakan, who resigned last month under pressure from the secularist military after a stormy year as Turkey's first Islamist prime minister.
